description: Discovers viral content trends and trending formats on TikTok using apidojo's TikTok scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: find trending content formats on TikTok, discover what is going viral on TikTok in a niche, identify viral TikTok hooks or video styles to adapt, research TikTok trends for a product category, find what content formats are performing best on TikTok right now, discover trending sounds or concepts in a niche on TikTok, or analyze what drives viral TikTok engagement in a specific category. Returns trending hashtags, view counts, engagement metrics, content format patterns, and hook analysis. Ideal for TikTok content creators, brand social teams, and video content strategists.
